title: Fall Creek high-chill field forum coverage
summary: Trade coverage of a Fall Creek grower event. Repeats the SEKOYA Nova figures published in the company press release and reports owner claims for 'FC11-164': described as the first machine-harvestable fresh-market variety, large and light blue, with firmness said to exceed any other variety and 60 or more days of storage.
why_it_matters: Supplies the only retrieved trait claims for 'FC11-164'. This article republishes company material and is not an independent measurement, so it does not raise the Nova figures above the status of an owner claim.

reading.rationale: Introduces a machine-harvest fresh-market claim that would be significant if substantiated.

testing.rationale: A claim of first machine-harvestable fresh-market variety is a direct trial question.

commercial_position.rationale: Material only if the claim survives independent testing.

monitoring.rationale: Track the commercial name release and any third-party trial results.
